theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → ∀ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, IntegrableOn (fun x => euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β) K μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
